format: pandas pickle (.pkl), one DataFrame per file; load with pandas.read_pickle or common.load_table. pyarrow is not installed under Python 3.14, so no parquet. Features are float32, categorical features are pandas categories with fixed category lists (common.CATEGORICAL), flags int8, targets float32 with NaN where undefined.
basis_rule: one model set per league: DEV priced with this league's engine calibration, scored on this league's own app values (TGS and BLM never mixed)

source.waa: backtest/.dev_cache/ml/waa_TGS/*.csv.gz.608cdff64c-TGS.json (TGS engine calibration, neutral park), picked by that tag

row_rule: one row per DEV player-dump with a priced now_WAA at ages 16-40; role = the role held in most of the player's dumps (dev_odds; a tie goes to the role of his first dump); features use only that dump and earlier dumps

targets.peak: max now_WAA over this dump and every later dump the engine priced; NaN unless peak_known
targets.peak_known: 1 when the player is seen at age >= 27 at some dump (realized, the app's rule) or retired (absent from every later dump while later dumps exist); constant per player
targets.gain: peak - now_WAA (never below 0); NaN unless peak_known
targets.reach_mlb: peak >= -1.0 (dev_odds PEAK_BARS mlb); NaN unless peak_known
targets.regular_future: 1 when some MLB season s > dump_year (a season played after this Jan-1 dump) has >= 300 PA or >= 150 BF (dev_mlb_pt, level_id 1); 0 when none and peak_known; else NaN. Differs from dev_odds' outcome, which counts any season of the career, including seasons already played (kept as regular_ever). Seasons start at 2026: the cache has no 2025 season.
targets.regular_ever: dev_odds' outcome: some season of the career (2026 on) with >= 300 PA or >= 150 BF; not censoring-aware, reference only
targets.waa_k: now_WAA at dump_year + k (k = 1..5); NaN when retired, not priced, or beyond the last dump
targets.present_k: 1 when the player is in the raw dump dump_year + k, 0 when absent (retired), NaN beyond the last dump

flags.realized: seen at age >= 27 at some dump (dev_odds / app definition)
flags.retired: absent from every dump after his last one while later dumps exist (players never come back)
flags.censored: still active at the last dump and never seen at 27+: peak and outcomes unknown
flags.cohort_first20: first seen at age <= 20 and ever in an org (dev_odds cohort without its year window)
flags.cohort_dev_odds: cohort_first20 and first seen from 2025 to the last banked dump minus 23 (dev_odds COHORT_YEARS exactly; the end moves with the last banked year)
flags.left_censored: first seen in the first dump (2025): his earlier years are unknown

info.dump_year: season just played; the dump is dated Jan 1 of dump_year + 1
info.now_kind: engine record the cache priced at this dump (H or P); differs from the role for a few position changers
info.lev_raw: raw dump Lev before the collapse / parked fix
info.mlb_pa: MLB PA in season dump_year (0 when none or unknown)
info.fold: 0..4, md5 of the pid string mod 5; every dump of a player in one fold
info.grow_steps_r_card: grow_steps_r BEFORE the card-replaced failsafe (the DEV card a year back as it is). Only the cell method reads it (baseline.py, as dev_odds builds its cells from every DEV card); never a model feature
info.has_prev_card: has_prev BEFORE the card-replaced failsafe; read with grow_steps_r_card by baseline.py only
info.time_split: train when first_seen_year <= the cutoff, else test
info.sim_depth: simulated archive depth of the row (history tables only): -1 = full record (about half the rows), else 0, 1, 2 or 3 seasons of archive (one eighth each); md5 of 'pid/dump_year' (common.sim_depth). common.apply_archive_depth() applies it; never a model feature
info.rec_start_pull: scoring rows (history tables only): pull id of E, the start of his record; -1 = none

folds.rule: fold = int(md5(str(pid)).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % 5 (common.fold_of); every dump of a player lands in one fold
folds.time_split: train = players first seen in dump years <= 2479, test = first seen after 2479; the cutoff is the latest year that leaves >= 4000 realized careers (seen at 27+, a row at ages 17-22, not left-censored) per role on the test side. A cutoff counting only finished careers would sit at 2158, where the test side is mostly early washouts (the recent debuts can finish only by retiring young) and its useful share falls below the train side's

level_rule: DEV Lev collapsed to none/R/A/AA/AAA/MLB; an MLB label with no MLB PA and no MLB BF in the season just played at age <= 22 reads R (parked international kids; 388445 rows); in_org uses the raw Lev (dev_odds ORG_LEV). The 2025 dump has no playing time, so its MLB labels are kept.

left_out.personality: not included. The DEV letters (WrkEthic, Int, Lead, Loy, Greed) are terciles that dump_vintages cut from the raw 1-200 values; the TGS / BLM letters are OOTP's own labels with other cut points (TGS work ethic N 68%, H 24%, L 8% vs DEV one third each), so the scales do not map
left_out.prone: DEV carries raw injury numbers, StatsPlus a text label; no known mapping

TGS.pull_rule: dev_signals.choose_clean_pulls: the pull nearest one game-year back whose pair with the latest pull ratings_db.pair_guard does not flag; growth / span

app_now_vs_cache_now.why: the app's now must match the neutral-park engine the DEV cache used; a gap here would mean a park or calibration layer in the app numbers

dropped_features.age_frac: TGS / BLM data carry no birth date, so the fractional age cannot be built there
dropped_features.grow2_steps: the TGS / BLM archives span under two game-years (TGS 2043-11 to 2045-07, BLM 2057-07 to 2058-10, and BLM's usable span starts after its 2057-12-31 scale event), so two-year growth is never known there
